verdict.rationale: Zapier's core product is Zap workflows that run on triggers such as polling and webhooks. Community reports describe Zaps executing unattended, for example a calendar-sync Zap that fired on a Sunday morning, and executions being metered per month. Zapier Agents built with Copilot are described as performing tasks across 9,000+ apps. missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing background or scheduled execution of Zaps, documentation of Agents running autonomously on triggers rather than on prompts, and monitoring or guardrails for unattended runs.
